🔶 PrimeCheck

A number appears and you must quickly determine whether it is prime (only divisible by 1 and itself). Free, no ads, no login — play instantly on Bytecade Games.

How to Play

  1. A number is shown — determine if it is a prime number.
  2. Click or select Yes if the number is prime, No if it is composite.
  3. Speed matters — answer quickly but accurately.
  4. Use divisibility tricks: check 2, 3, 5, 7, 11, 13... systematically.
  5. Numbers ending in 0, 2, 4, 5, 6, 8 are often easier to check.
